answer: The linchpin is Finisher sewn quire seal stitched into the cord loft register: remove it and the farm walks in; keep it and the farm pays each sewn quire is a measured binding yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must per alias. No bulk discount exists: 654 aliases need 654 proofs, and each proof is 119 POA the farm cannot reuse. Without a quill there is no proof, without a horizon there is no deterrent, and without a ledge there is no audit. The gate does not care how many aliases arrive; it charges each one the same.
